tasks.title: Conversation #71
tasks.transcript:
Man: I've been thinking about getting into bird watching, any tips?
Woman: Sure, a good pair of binoculars is essential and instead of a guidebook, I'd recommend a mobile app. It helps you identify species and log sightings.
Man: I actually have an old field guide, but it's missing pages and doesn't cover local birds.
Woman: Then get an app. Some of them even alert you when there's a rare sighting nearby. That's my favorite feature.
Man: Impressive, so I'd like to join your group, too.
Woman: We'd love to have you. I'll send you a link to our calendar of events, including local walks.

questions.stem: What is the woman's favorite feature of a mobile app?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：女士最喜欢的手机应用功能是什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Some of them even alert you when there's a rare sighting nearby. That's my favorite feature. 选项分析： A. 每月的迁徙更新。对话中没有提到迁徙更新，因此 A 选项错误。 B. 小组讨论论坛。对话中没有提到论坛功能，因此 B 选项错误。 C. 警报系统。女士明确指出当附近有稀有鸟类出现时应用会发出警报，这是她最喜欢的功能，因此 C 选项正确。 D. 鸟类百科全书。女士提到应用帮助识别物种，但没有说最喜欢这个功能，因此 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: What will the woman most likely do next?

options.A: Provide the man with a calendar
options.B: Send the man a link to an app
options.C: Join the man for a walk
options.D: Help the man repair a book

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士接下来最可能做什么？ 定位原文：Woman: I'll send you a link to our calendar of events, including local walks. 选项分析： A. 提供给男士一个日历。女士明确说要发送活动日历的链接，因此 A 选项正确。 B. 发送给男士一个应用的链接。女士提到的是日历链接，而非应用链接，因此 B 选项错误。 C. 和男士一起去散步。女士没有说会和他一起走，只是提供活动日历，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 帮助男士修补一本书。对话中提到男士有一本旧的野外指南，但女士没有提出帮忙修补，因此 D 选项错误。
